name: 64040 · Holden, MO
findings: ZIP 64040 (Holden) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64040 (Holden) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 64040 (Holden) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
